method: One reviewer (me, an AI agent) read each verified candidate claim against its quote. 'unsupported' = claim adds or changes something the quote does not say, or the quote is a fragment or garbled. 'duplicate' = same quote already chosen. 'out_of_scope' = Imperial Gazetteer entries for Bombay Presidency towns that are not Bombay city.
supported_rate: 96 of 114 in-scope reviewed claims supported (84.2%); the 18 unsupported were removed
